instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a group playing frisbee in a grassy park. In the foreground, a large Black man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) stands on the left, holding a blue frisbee. On the right, a woman in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans (R4) faces him with hands raised defensively. In the background, an Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3), a woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) holding an orange disc, and a Black woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6) watch. The scene is lit by soft natural daylight.

R5 holds an orange disc while R3, R6, and others watch
R3, R5, and R6 are background watchers while R1 and R4 are the foreground interaction pair
